about.title: WHO WE ARE
about.heading: UdG Racing Division is the University of Girona's competition team dedicated to innovation in motorsport.
about.paragraph1: We are a multidisciplinary team of University of Girona students committed to competing in Formula Student. We design, build, and race a single-seater that combines performance and efficiency. Our mission is to train the next generation of motorsport engineers while pushing the boundaries of technology.
about.paragraph2: To achieve this goal, we work across mechanical engineering, electronics, aerodynamics, design, and project management. Every member contributes their unique skills to create a competitive vehicle capable of representing the excellence of our team.

team.title: THE TEAM
team.description: We are a multidisciplinary team from the University of Girona, focused on a single goal: building a race car and competing. Every season is a new challenge to push technical boundaries and improve our on-track performance. Get in touch with us and become part of our team!

questions.question: Who can join the team?
questions.answer: The team is open to all students from the University of Girona and its partner institutions. If you do not yet have the experience required to take on every task, you can join the UdG Racing Academy, where you will gain the knowledge and skills needed to grow within the team.

questions.question: How can I sponsor the team?
questions.answer: Contact us via the form or by emailing info@udgracingdivision.cat. We offer different sponsorship tiers.

questions.question: What competitions do you participate in?
questions.answer: We mainly participate in Formula Student, competing in various international circuits.
